Specification: This specification models a very small single-variable system with state variable x. The initial condition allows x to take any value in the integer range 1..10, and the next-state action sets x' to 0 in one step. It defines the standard temporal specification Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars, and also includes a helper function F(a) returning the empty set together with const_4711 == F(x), which a comment states is intended to be used as a model constraint that triggers an EvalException because it does not return a Boolean value. The property NotNine asserts that x is not equal to 9, and this is false in one of the allowed initial states.
